miriam: Heads up: PR #2987 (render cache cleanup) is blocked by macOS smoke failing. Need 1-2 approves to merge and we'll trigger a targeted rerun. :wave:
buildkite-bot: buildkite-bot: macos-smoke shard-3 failed on agent-12. Test failing: render_cache_test::FrameSnapshotDiff. Logs:
```
Error: snapshot mismatch at render_cache/frame_42.png
Expected: hash=ab12c3
Actual:   hash=ab12d4
Stack: frame_render.cpp:213
```
sam: on it :eyes: I can review in ~30m. Is this consistently failing or flaky?
miriam: Only failed on that one shard twice in the last 6 runs, others green. Probably flaky. I can try a targeted rerun after an approve.
john: If it's just a snapshot mismatch we'll need a snapshot update. Can you paste the diff? If it's timing-related, rerun first.
miriam: ```
--- expected/frame_42.png
+++ actual/frame_42.png
@@
-pixel(102,58)=#ffffff
+pixel(102,58)=#fafafa
```
carol: I looked — looks like rendering antialiasing noise. Might be nondet on mac retina. I'd prefer rerun then snapshot update if reproduces. Happy to approve after CI passes.
miriam: I'll queue a targeted rerun now once we have at least 1 approve.
sam: Approve from me. :+1: (leaving a brief review comment on the PR)
buildkite-bot: buildkite-bot: queued targeted rerun for PR 2987 on macos-smoke shard-3. Link: https://buildkite.redwood-inference/abc123
miriam: Thanks @sam. If rerun fails again I'll open a quick revert or push a small nondet guard.
carol: Noted. If it flakes again tag me and I'll take a closer look. :ok_hand:
